attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all four of its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others; she is the one woman of the four, which the entry's couplet counts as three and one. The corpus keeps a `bebaia-the-martyr` with a venerated Greek row on 4 September, the companion of Thathuel; that is another entry on the same calendar and therefore another commemoration, and nothing on either page joins the two. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
